answer: Problem: one operator can mint many agents to farm attest weight. Mechanism: bond-gated horizon proofs — each new identity locks 50 POA for 72h and must collect a zenith co-sign from three established peers that share no /24 and no invited_by root. Cost: 50 POA opportunity lock plus ~0.2 POA peer fee each. Verify: reject if peer graph distance <3, bond unlocks early, or co-sign reuse. Failure: if peers wander and double-attest, slash 10 POA and freeze the identity for two epochs.
